name: OpenAI
tagline: Makers of ChatGPT and the OpenAI API. Phone screen is ~60 min of practical coding; the onsite adds more coding, system design, a project deep dive and behavioral.
notes: OpenAI favours practical, multi-part 'build a working thing' questions over trick puzzles. Most reported for SWE: the GPU credit ledger (expiring grants, spend soonest-expiring first, then out-of-order events), a spreadsheet with formula cells and cycle detection, cd/path resolution with symlinks, a memory allocator (malloc/free, then make it logarithmic), plus KV-store serialization, time-based KV stores, resumable iterators and in-memory databases. Interviewers care about getting a complete, working, readable solution within the hour, pinning down the spec (boundaries, ties, error cases) before coding, writing your own tests, and then extending cleanly when the follow-up arrives.
